instruction: Repo owner, live in this conversation, was asked whether to deploy now and whether to isolate just the two live-incident fixes or merge the whole sdlc-supervisor framework too, and explicitly chose: merge everything, including the sdlc-supervisor framework, to master now. feature/favorites-two-column-layout is a descendant of feature/sdlc-supervisor and also carries the B23.1 artist.genres crash fix, so merging it brings all three.
notes: Preflight before writing this record: backend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; backend `npx vitest run` -> 45 test files / 388 tests passed; frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; frontend `npm run build` succeeded. Added a version bump (config.yaml 1.0.24 -> 1.0.25) and matching CHANGELOG.md entry in commit bcc1a3d before merging, since the branch is user-visible (crash fix + two-column layout) and had not bumped the version -- required for the HA Supervisor to offer the update at all. Action taken: `git checkout master` (was already up to date with origin/master at e1552ab), `git merge --no-ff feature/favorites-two-column-layout` -> clean merge (ort strategy, no conflicts) producing 78f3998bd993bbff9a3e3ccbd9693c6d2c7b7018.
